content.thinking: My test bug: `pipe(r)` returns bytes, and I passed `b'...'.hex()` (a str) to startswith. Let me fix: use the bytes directly.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('test_bridge4.py').read()
src = src.replace("""check('escape-case', pipe(r).startswith(b'GET /a%2fB%2Fc?x=%FA HTTP/1.1\\r\\n'.hex()) or pipe(r).startswith(b'GET /a%2fB%2Fc?x=%Fa HTTP/1.1\\r\\n'), pipe(r)[:60])""",
"""check('escape-case', pipe(r).startswith(b'GET /a%2fB%2Fc?x=%Fa HTTP/1.1\\r\\n'), pipe(r)[:60])""")
open('test_bridge4.py','w').write(src)
EOF
python3 test_bridge4.py
